evaluation_criteria.title: Corporate profile

evaluation_criteria.notes: Proponents must demonstrate capabilities and capacity by describing team (internal and external resources). Maximum 4 individuals in dedicated relationship or coordination roles (e.g., consultant, facilitator, project manager). Each profile limited to half a page maximum, including name, proposed role, years of relevant experience, areas of specialization, professional designations, certifications, and credentials.

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to demonstrate their capabilities and capacity to provide the required services by describing their team, including internal and external resources. The response should include: A brief profile (no more than half a page) for each individual (maximum of 4) who would serve in a dedicated relationship or coordination role with the Bank — for example, a consultant, facilitator or project manager. These are the people we expect to interact with consistently, independent of any specific engagement. The profile should include: name and proposed role, years of relevant experience, areas of specialization, professional designations, certifications, and credentials.
